checkpoints.reasoning: Introductions only. Family money, disputed early work, unpaid commissions, donor catering instructions and collecting grudges offer faint motives, without murder evidence.

Artie faces removal; education faces cuts; artists lose credit. Cyanide bottle and private glass suggest possible poison route, placing conservation, security and service in focus. No death or timing yet.
Death after private toast makes the service glass, camera privacy and historical poison relevant. Artie benefits from unsigned gift failing, but proposals were still negotiable. No decisive suspect.

Hugh faces public fraud exposure and altered records, a stronger immediate threat than ordinary credit disputes. Artie, Al and Penny have serious stakes; Barb and Brie have apparent access. Everyone supplies a credible grievance, leaving means and timing unresolved.

Individual glass poisoned while shared food is clean; the unattended setup gives a broad pre-service window. Active loan bottle with concealed split makes object knowledge/handling central. Chip and Brie join Hugh as leaders, but there is still no link between any suspect and both objects.

Brie admits adding flavoring at the prepared glass, the most direct contamination opportunity. Hugh knew original contents and concealed correspondence; Chip fitted the split band. Tess, Al, Dada and Barb visited the glass; Fact and Reed knew the contents discrepancy. No one yet uniquely spans knowledge and access.

Clean retained flavoring weakens the simple Brie theory without excluding direct poisoning. Staff received full contents warning and ordinary keys work, broadening knowledgeable access. Physical bottle and exposed glass eliminate several staging/substitution stories; no torn-edge match uniquely incriminates Chip. Family succession and several financial disputes weaken, but Hugh, Chip, Barb, Fact, Reed and Brie remain close.

Al uniquely contradicts the physical sample: his surface has bronze powder and gold transfer leaf, yet he claims personally cutting red-faced silver-backed leaf and identifies the glass scrap as his sculpture. This looks like deliberate diversion of closure evidence. He attended the bottle preview and sat beside the prepared glass, with payment grievance. Other final statements mostly reconcile records.

final_feedback.fairness: The final accusation is earned through a concrete material contradiction already present in the documentary packet. It supports a compelling guilty inference rather than an airtight proof: a lie about scrap could conceal lesser wrongdoing. Before the final speech several suspects remained similarly viable.
final_feedback.remaining_plausible_alternatives: Chip Patina supplied the closure stock, changed an insurance date, had bottle expertise and staff access. Brie DeVivre directly flavored the glass and could have added poison separately despite her clean container. Hugh Bidder knew original contents, attended the preview and had damaging dealings to conceal, though withdrawal of the refund demand weakens his immediate motive.
final_feedback.contrivance: A historical active cyanide bottle at a gala needs some suspension of disbelief, but original-contents sale, warning and restricted preview make the route understandable. The very specific guilty material claim conveniently falls into the precise lab contradiction. Twenty-two parallel admissions and dense administrative receipts sometimes feel engineered.
final_feedback.voice: Final speeches mostly explain facts and exclusions to players, often in the same confession-plus-personal-address format. Human grief, payroll worry, school funding and calling home give individual texture. Al supplies the pivotal puzzle interpretation by asserting an alternative scrap origin; Barb also explicates the camera distinction. Overall warmer than a bare clue recital, but still conspicuously explanatory.

post_vote_feedback: Al confirms the material-contradiction inference and the preview-to-glass route without adding an essential missing clue. His motive connects publicity fraud and home obligations well. The confession openly acknowledges the scrap is not a unique match, preserving the distinction between strong inference and laboratory certainty. Innocent endings give satisfying personal consequences and relationship repairs, but their repeated denial/document explanation/lesson structure is conspicuous across 22 voices. No ratings or accusation changed after reading endings.
